SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

A reliable month-by-month fishing window has not been established from the inspected material for this particular trip. Ask the local operator or fisheries service to confirm the target, access and conditions for your dates before making non-refundable arrangements.

The decision that shapes this trip

Request the target and technique for your dates directly from the operator. Keep this island program separate from Viti Levu departures, and check transfer arrangements and tackle provision before making purchases.

Build around a confirmed boat plan

Ask the crew to identify the primary target and method, the actual time spent fishing and how anglers share the available positions. Confirm the tackle that is supplied before buying rods or terminal gear. Keep spare clothing and electronics protected from spray.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Fiji

Fiji has no individual recreational fishing licence for visitors. A commercial charter must hold the appropriate licence, and customary fishing rights still apply.

Official rules ↗

Permits for this trip

  • Qoliqoli access permission — conditional ↗
    Visitors whose Taveuni — Makaira trip enters customary fishing grounds Arrange local rights-holder access through the licensed charter before fishing.

Rules for this water

  • The charter must hold the applicable commercial licence and address customary qoliqoli access.
  • The kawakawa and donu seasonal ban runs from June through September.
  • Confirm the chosen reef's customary closures before fishing; offshore charter approval does not settle reef access.

Full Fiji licence guide ↗ · Checked November 2026.
